29/G.goal: Explain how auditory perception supports immersive XR experiences by connecting the role of audio to the physical nature of sound and the human hearing system.
29/G.achieves: Equips the learner with foundational knowledge of the auditory sense needed to understand and evaluate immersive XR experiences as part of the course's human-factors and system-development goals.

29/O1.goal: Explain why auditory sense enhances immersive XR experiences by complementing visual perception to support believability and presence.
29/O1.achieves: Establishes the human-factors rationale for including audio in XR systems, helping the learner understand why auditory features matter when designing immersive experiences.

29/O2.goal: Trace how sound is characterized as a pressure wave and converted by the human ear into neural impulses.
29/O2.achieves: Provides the physical and perceptual foundation for understanding how audio is received and experienced in immersive XR systems.
